entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What the hell!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A safe!? This wasn't here the last time[n]we came!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He changed the entire room so quickly...[n]Tch, I guess this Palace isn't a bank for[n]nothing.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Greetings. Welcome to my private[n]city bank.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: I'm surprised you made it here alive.[n]It seems you are quite lucky.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Lucky? Don't be ridiculous.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gonna change your heart and[n]make you confess everything you've[n]done.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That'll save all those people who're[n]suffering 'cause of your shitty actions.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Even the police're strugglin' to deal with[n]you, so this'll make the public believe[n]in us too!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Those in power work the ones below[n]them to the bone for money. Such is[n]the hierarchy of the world.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Just accept your fate as a source[n]of my wealth!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We'll never agree to that!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And hierarchy? You have to be out of[n]your mind.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: All of that was forced on me too,[n]you know!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: I went through shit until I crawled my[n]way out of the dregs! Now it's my turn[n]to profit on everyone else!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Still! Don't you think you're getting back[n]at the wrong people?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What a pitiful man.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: It doesn't matter whether you're clean or[n]dirty! Only the clever come out on top!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: The strong and the smart devour[n]the weak. That is the natural order[n]of things.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: You damn brats who think you know[n]the world through the shit you read[n]online will make perfect prey.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hmph. He is utterly hopeless.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: It's always the fools who get tricked![n]Fools who have to pay for their[n]foolishness.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: And if those fools don't learn, well they[n]have to suck it up and stay as plain,[n]stupid fools!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Will you just shut it already!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: I guess there's not much point saying[n]anything to you fools!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: This is where my gracious lecture ends.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Now then, I hope you're ready to work[n]as slaves here for the rest of your lives.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's outrageous!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: *snicker* I'm gonna swarm all over you...[n]and squeeze out every last penny!
